description: Node-centered heat-diffusion probes on the fixed weighted Zachary karate-club interaction graph; club labels are not used.
domain: real social interaction network / weighted undirected graph

invariant_parameters.parameter_policy: same graph-aligned load/formation/recursion coefficients already used by the real time-series carriers; no target fit
invariant_parameters.probe_family: all 34 observed nodes, one heat-diffusion probe each

measurement_mapping.D: normalized heat-diffusion state exp(-t L_n) e_i from the focal observed node
measurement_mapping.K: normalized observed graph Laplacian plus fixed offset minus one diffusion-supported formation mode
measurement_mapping.R_C: observed graph-Laplacian eigenbasis with low persistent unit-modulus modes and contractive complement
measurement_mapping.Y: PSD squared normalized observed graph Laplacian plus scalar probe-complement stress

name: Zachary Karate Weighted Interaction BFG Carrier
